seed_ledger.name: South Carolina Public Service Authority: gas supply to its plants in development
seed_ledger.reason: IRP power station 1 (1296 MW): NOT_FOUND. IRP power station 2 (449 MW): NOT_FOUND. Both are unnamed planning placeholders; the 2026 Santee Cooper IRP models a single 1x1 combined cycle plant in 2035 with no site, pipeline or data center tie, so neither has its own filing. The real gas project, the Canadys joint plant with Dominion, is already handled as roster row P8146 (Elba Express Bridge) by the utility-a run for the Dominion seed. Searches run: 4. Sources checked: Santee Cooper 2026 triennial IRP (2035 combined cycle needed for load growth and Winyah retirement, no site or pipeline named), web searches on Canadys pipeline and data center (Kinder Morgan Elba Bridge, already P8146), utility-a found_seeds-8 ledger.

evidence.note: 2035 NGCC placeholder, no site or pipeline; data center construction named only as a general load driver

seed_ledger.name: ALLETE Inc: gas supply to its plants in development
seed_ledger.reason: Minnesota Power 2025 IRP station (750 MW): NO_DC_TIE and NOT_FOUND. No site or pipeline named, and the state commission rejected the plant in 2026 and ordered new gas alternatives studied. Nemadji Trail energy center (625 MW): NO_DC_TIE. Gas comes by a new 16-inch lateral of about 7 miles built by Superior Water Light and Power to Great Lakes Gas Transmission, but no filing, developer or utility source ties the plant to data center load, and it is a power plant lateral under 25 km. Boswell Energy Center (364 MW): NO_DC_TIE. Unit 3 gas conversion approved September 2026 with no new pipeline or data center tie found. Searches run: 6. Sources checked: Wisconsin PSC Nemadji case page (16-inch lateral to Great Lakes, no data center), Minnesota news on the September 2026 Boswell decision (conversion only), IRP coverage (large-load growth in general, plant rejected), roster grep (no Superior lateral row).

evidence.note: Nemadji Trail 16-inch lateral by Superior Water Light and Power, no data center tie
